methods.name: Threshold-based Image Difference and Principal Component Analysis-based K-means
methods.summary: The method involves band ratio preprocessing to highlight landslide features, followed by either a threshold-based Image Difference (ID) method using Otsu thresholding or a PCA-based K-means unsupervised learning classification to detect landslide clusters from multi-temporal optical images.

availability.author_statement: Data are contained within the article. The corresponding author can provide the necessary model upon request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
